title: Giving a Presentation

expressions.example: First of all, I'd like to thank you all.

expressions.expr: Moving on to the next point...
expressions.example: Moving on to the next point, let's look at sales.
To sum up, our sales have increased.
Thank you for your attention, any questions?

sentences: First of all, I'd like to thank you all for coming.
Moving on, let's look at the next chart.
To sum up, our sales have increased this quarter.
In conclusion, we recommend expanding into new markets.
I'd like to highlight the key points of this project.
Furthermore, we need more data before deciding.
As a result, the team decided to change strategy.
Thank you for your attention, are there any questions?

grammar.title: Presentation Language — Structuring Your Talk
rules: "First of all" abre a apresentação e organiza o primeiro ponto.
"Moving on" sinaliza transição para o próximo tópico.
"To sum up / In conclusion" fecham a apresentação resumindo as ideias principais.
Linking words como "furthermore" e "as a result" conectam ideias e mostram consequência.
